Alex: Updated plan based on replies: A1 -> Sam (due 2026-03-20, fallback verification after PR merge; contingency 2026-03-22), A2 -> Marta (due 2026-03-25), A3 -> Ben (due 2026-03-18 + SRE review), A4 -> Eng-Infra (Julia) (maintenance 2026-03-20 02:00-04:00 UTC).

Alex: I'll update the RCA doc with these assignments and set a follow-up checkpoint Mon 2026-03-22 14:00 UTC (calendar invite incoming). If anyone needs a different date or owner, reply here. :thumbsup:
